Key carry-overs with fresh data justification: PANW (Q4 guidance: NGS ARR +60% YoY, new 52-week high), CRWD (only -3.8% off highs, PANW read-across catalyst Sept 1), MPC (only -0.3% off 52-week high, Iran supply bid intact), MSFT (+23.5% 1M, Azure $100B milestone, Ackman 5.65M share add), RTX (only -0.5% off high, defense capex structural), SPGI (capital markets activity at peak, 60-day re-underwrite justified by curve steepening), NET (+60.1% vs SPY 3M, Druckenmiller new position), ANET (82% operating margin, -5.5% off high), AMGN (-0.6% off 52-week high, 17x forward P/E vs sector at 18x), LLY (healthcare Tier 2 leader, GLP-1 duopoly execution). SNOW is excluded despite #1 momentum rank — it reports September 2 while running +118% over 3 months at -2.5% off all-time highs with CFO transition risk; the risk/reward into earnings does not justify adding a new position today. PLTR is excluded on 175x P/E at 41x forward revenue with Burry short and DoD concentration risk. NVDA was held 1 day and exits today — the dominant risk being underwritten is the AI capex bubble and multiple compression scenario, which is most acute for names that share NVDA's hyperscaler dependency.
